page.name: Healthcare & clinics
page.metaDescription: Appointment reminders, schedule changes and administrative notices over your own messaging accounts, with the send path and logs kept under your control.
page.lede: Most clinic messaging is administrative, and a missed administrative message costs a wasted appointment slot. Send a confirmation at booking and a timed reminder before, on the number the patient gave you — and keep clinical detail out of it.

bullets: Reminders at a fixed interval before the appointment
p: The pattern that works is a confirmation plus a timed reminder, on the same number the patient booked with, with a one-tap way to change the appointment. Everything else is noise that trains people to ignore the channel.

sections.h: Keep clinical detail out of the message
p: The platform stores no message bodies — the log keeps metadata only, which removes one place detail could accumulate. What the message says is still yours to decide: content passes through your provider and lands on a handset that may be shared. The practical rule is to send a reference the patient resolves in your own portal rather than the clinical detail itself.

sections.h: Consent and records stay on your side
p: Who may be contacted, what may be said, and how long records are kept are clinical and professional obligations, and they stay where the duty sits — with the healthcare provider. The platform’s part is getting the message there reliably and keeping a record of the send.

faq.q: Do you sign a BAA or equivalent?
faq.a: Nothing on this site makes that claim. Any agreement of that kind is a contractual matter between you and Whaleal, not a feature of the platform.

faq.q: Can patients reply to a reminder?
faq.a: Replies on the SMS channel can be captured as inbound messages for opt-out handling, but the platform is not an interactive appointment system. The practical pattern is to include a link back to your own booking page.

faq.q: Can reminders be sent on more than one channel?
faq.a: You can connect the accounts you already hold on each channel. Opt-out suppression applies to marketing sends on every channel, and delivery receipts are normalized wherever the provider reports them back — every SMS provider, Resend on email and Meta on WhatsApp.
